chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from one of his companions from Abu Hamza from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Seek the children from the mothers, for in their wombs is the blessing.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of seeking children from mothers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In the context of al-Kulayni’s discussion on concubines, this hadith underscores the spiritual sanctity of the mother’s womb as a source of divine barakah, reinforcing the status of women in lineage and conception. It serves to elevate the mother’s role beyond mere biological function, linking physical progeny to spiritual blessing, a concept deeply valued in Shia jurisprudence regarding family structure.
